les: Sewe gelowe, en waaraan jy elkeen ken - deel 1
kaps_punt: Kennis van die meerderheidsgelowe in Suid-Afrika (deel 1 van 2): Judaïsme, Christendom, Islam, Hindoeïsme: Betekenisvolle plekke, geboue en aanbiddingsimbole van verskillende religieë.

items.bewering: In elke dorp en stad staan geboue waar mense bid en aanbid.
items.bron: Stats SA General Household Survey 2013 (84.2% Christian) and Census 2022 (85.3% Christian), via Schoeman, HTS Teologiese Studies 2017 (https://hts.org.za/index.php/hts/article/view/3837/9246) and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Religion_in_South_Africa. With more than four in five South Africans Christian, a place of worship in every town holds. The universal 'elke' is acceptable here.

items.bewering: Van buite af kan jy dikwels sien watter geloof daar aanbid word. Party geboue dra 'n teken bo-op en ander het 'n hoë toring.
items.bron: Crosses on churches (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christian_cross) and minarets on mosques (https://www.metmuseum.org/learn/educators/curriculum-resources/art-of-the-islamic-world/unit-one/the-mosque). The claim is hedged with 'dikwels' and 'party', which is correct.

items.bewering: Hierdie les en die volgende een kyk na sewe van die gelowe in Suid-Afrika.
items.bron: The CAPS Life Skills Gr 4 content on major religions in South Africa names seven: Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, the Baha'i Faith and African Religion (CAPS Life Skills Intermediate Phase, https://www.thutong.doe.gov.za/ResourceDownload.aspx?id=43252; summarised in search results). Four are here and three are left for part 2. The phrase 'sewe van die gelowe' correctly does not claim that these are all the faiths.

items.bewering: Joodse mense kom in 'n sinagoge bymekaar om te bid en te leer.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synagogue ; https://www.britannica.com/topic/synagogue: a house of prayer and of study.

items.bewering: Voor in die sinagoge staan 'n kas met die Torah-rolle daarin.
items.bron: Chabad.org, 'What Is a Torah Scroll?' (https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/333007/jewish/What-Is-a-Torah-Scroll.htm): 'Kept in the Ark of each synagogue'. The Ark (Aron Kodesh) stands on the wall at the front of the prayer hall.

items.bewering: 'n Torah-rol is 'n lang boekrol wat met die hand geskryf word. Iemand rol dit oop en lees hardop daaruit voor.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torah_scroll ; https://www.britannica.com/topic/Sefer-Torah: handwritten by a scribe (sofer) on sheets of parchment sewn into a long scroll, and read aloud in the synagogue (Chabad.org, same page as above).

items.bewering: In baie sinagoges sien jy ook 'n menora. Dit is 'n lamp met verskeie arms wat elkeen 'n lig dra.
items.bron: https://www.britannica.com/topic/menorah ; https://jewishvirtuallibrary.org/the-menorah: a many-branched lamp (seven in the Temple menorah) used as a decoration and traditional symbol in synagogues and Jewish homes. The qualifier 'baie' is correct.

items.bewering: Die Westelike Muur in Jerusalem is 'n plek waarheen Joodse mense van oral af reis. Dit is 'n hoë muur van groot ou klipblokke.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Western_Wall: an ancient limestone wall with an exposed height of about 19 m, built of very large meleke limestone blocks; a pilgrimage and prayer site for Jews worldwide.

items.bewering: Mense staan digby die muur en bid daar hardop of stil. Party skryf 'n gebed op 'n papiertjie en steek dit tussen die klippe in.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kvitel: the custom of putting written prayers (kvitlach) in the cracks between the stones is at least 300 years old, with more than a million notes a year. 'Party' is correctly scoped.

items.bewering: Christene kom in 'n kerkgebou bymekaar om saam te aanbid. Sommige kerke is klein sale en ander is groot geboue met 'n toring.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Church_(building). The range from small halls to large towered buildings is correct, and the claim is hedged with 'sommige/ander'.

items.bewering: Baie kerke lui 'n klok wanneer die diens begin.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Church_bell ; WELS FAQ (https://wels.net/faq/church-bells/): bells call people to worship before the service and announce its start. 'Baie' is correctly scoped.

items.bewering: By baie kerke is die kruis die teken waaraan jy die gebou ken. 'n Kruis is twee balke wat oor mekaar lê. Jy sien dit bo-op die dak, binne teen die muur en om mense se nekke.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christian_cross ; https://www.britannica.com/topic/cross-religious-symbol: the principal symbol of Christianity, shown on and inside church buildings and worn as a pendant. The description of the shape is correct.

items.bewering: Baie kerke het rye banke en 'n tafel of preekstoel voor. Binne sing die mense saam, bid saam en luister na 'n preek.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pulpit ; https://www.britannica.com/technology/pulpit. The second sentence reads as a continuation of 'baie kerke', so it is not a claim about every Christian gathering.

items.bewering: Moria lê in Limpopo en is 'n plek waarheen mense van ver af reis. Mense van die Zion Christian Church (ZCC) kom elke jaar met Paasfees daar bymekaar.
items.bron: Daily Maverick, 'Moria: The road to Zion' (https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2012-04-10-moria-the-road-to-zion/); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zion_Christian_Church; Financial Mail, 26 March 2026 (https://fm.co.za/news-and-fox/2026-03-26-profits-of-the-moria-pilgrimage/). Zion City Moria near Polokwane, Limpopo, is the ZCC headquarters, with an annual Easter pilgrimage of millions. The claim is correctly scoped to the ZCC rather than to all Christians. For the record, and not as a fault: the pilgrimage was suspended from 2020 to 2023 because of Covid-19 (News24, 4 April 2023, https://www.news24.com/southafrica/news/still-no-annual-easter-pilgrimage-to-moria-says-zcc-20230404) and has since resumed, so 'elke jaar' correctly describes the current custom.

items.bewering: Moslems kom in 'n moskee bymekaar om saam te bid. By baie moskees staan 'n hoë dun toring met die naam minaret. Van die minaret af word die mense na die gebed geroep.
items.bron: https://www.metmuseum.org/learn/educators/curriculum-resources/art-of-the-islamic-world/unit-one/the-mosque ; https://www.learnreligions.com/parts-of-a-mosque-2004464 ; Pluralism Project (https://pluralism.org/mosque-minaret-and-mihrab): the minaret is the tower from which the call to prayer (adhan) goes out. Today this is usually done through loudspeakers on the minaret, which does not make the sentence false.

items.bewering: Binne lê matte op die vloer en mense trek hulle skoene uit.
items.bron: https://www.reonline.org.uk/lived-religion-and-worldview-traditions/muslim-lived-religion-and-worldview-traditions/muslim-places-of-worship/ ; Birmingham Central Mosque (https://centralmosque.org.uk/services/facilities): shoes are removed and the prayer hall is covered with carpets. This holds for mosques generally.

items.bewering: 'n Nis in een muur wys watter kant toe die mense moet draai. Hulle draai na die Kaaba in Mekka, ver in Saoedi-Arabië.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mihrab: 'a niche in the wall of a mosque that indicates the qibla, the direction of the Kaaba in Mecca'. Mecca is in Saudi Arabia. All Muslims pray facing the qibla, so the general claim holds.

items.bewering: Die Kaaba is 'n gebou in die vorm van 'n kubus. 'n Groot swart doek hang oor die mure.
items.bron: Britannica Kids / Britannica 'Kaaba' (https://kids.britannica.com/students/article/Kaaba/44246): 'cube-shaped structure (the word ka'bah means "cube" in Arabic)', about 15 m high on a base of about 10 by 12 m, so an approximate cube, as Britannica itself describes it. It is covered by the kiswah, a black cloth (https://theconversation.com/the-sacred-cloth-at-the-center-of-the-hajj-pilgrimage-281995).

items.bewering: Gelowiges van oral in die wêreld reis soontoe.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaaba ; Britannica: Muslims from around the world make the pilgrimage (hajj/umrah) to the Kaaba.

items.bewering: Die Auwalmoskee staan tussen die huise van die Bo-Kaap in Kaapstad.
items.bron: South African History Online, 'Auwal Masjid, Cape Town' (https://sahistory.org.za/place/auwal-masjid-cape-town): Dorp Street, Bo-Kaap. The mosque's own history page (https://www.auwalmasjid.co.za/index.php/history-of-the-auwal-masjid/) agrees.

items.bewering: Dit was die eerste moskee in Suid-Afrika.
items.bron: South African History Online (https://sahistory.org.za/place/auwal-masjid-cape-town): 'The Auwal Masjid, is the first and oldest Mosque built in South Africa', founded in 1794. Also https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Auwal_Mosque and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_mosques_in_South_Africa. SAHO adds that the distinction concerns a mosque building with public prayer, not the earliest Muslim prayer in the country. The lesson says 'moskee', which fits that exactly, so no softening is needed.

items.bewering: Hindoes gaan na 'n gebou met die naam tempel om daar te aanbid. Baie Hindoe-tempels is van buite af helder geverf en fyn versier.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gopuram: the gateway towers of South Indian temples are covered with brightly painted stucco figures and are repainted about every 12 years. Durban's temples follow South Indian traditions (Umgeni Road Temple, https://umgeniroadtemple.co.za/; SAHO, https://sahistory.org.za/place/first-second-river-temples). 'Baie' is correctly scoped: not every temple is brightly painted, and the Second River Temple, for example, uses face brick.

items.bewering: Mense trek hulle skoene uit voordat hulle die tempel binnegaan. Binne staan altare, en mense bring blomme en vrugte daarheen.
items.bron: Britannica 'Puja' (https://www.britannica.com/topic/puja): in its simplest form an offering of flowers or fruit to the image of a god, at shrines in the temple or at home. Shoes are removed on entering a temple (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Worship_in_Hinduism).

items.bewering: Die Om-teken is 'n teken wat jy by Hindoe-tempels en in huise sien. Dit is 'n geskrewe teken en ook 'n klank wat mense hardop sê.
items.bron: Britannica 'Om' (https://www.britannica.com/topic/Om-Indian-religion): a sacred syllable spoken at the beginning and end of prayers and chants, with a written symbol in use since the 6th century. Hindu American Foundation (https://www.hinduamerican.org/blog/5-things-to-know-about-om).

items.bewering: By die aanbidding steek mense 'n klein lampie met olie aan. Die vlammetjie brand voor die altaar en die mense sing daarby.
items.bron: Pluralism Project, 'Lamp Offerings: Hindu Worship' (https://pluralism.org/lamp-offerings-hindu-worship); Britannica 'Puja': in aarti a lamp (oil or ghee wicks, sometimes camphor) is moved before the deity while devotional songs are sung. Ghee and camphor are also used, but 'olie' is a fair simplification and not wrong.

items.bewering: Durban het baie Hindoe-tempels waar mense by groot feeste bymekaarkom.
items.bron: SAHO 'Hinduism' (https://sahistory.org.za/article/hinduism); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hinduism_in_South_Africa: KwaZulu-Natal has the largest Hindu community in the country (3.9% of the province, GHS 2013), and Durban has many temples (Umgeni Road Temple from 1883, Second River Temple from 1875) with large Diwali and Kavadi celebrations.

items.bewering: Baie gesinne aanbid elke dag by 'n klein altaar in hulle eie huis.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Worship_in_Hinduism ; Britannica 'Puja': daily worship (nitya puja) at the home shrine, often simply lighting a lamp. 'Baie gesinne' is correctly scoped.

items.bewering: Om hulle te herken, is 'n eerste stap om ander se geloof te eerbiedig.
items.blok: Om te herken en te eerbiedig
items.bron: Recorded because it contains 'eerste'. It is 'n eerste stap', a value statement about a step in learning and not a factual superlative, so there is nothing to verify externally and nothing false in it. The rest of the block ('Jy hoef nie aan 'n geloof te behoort om sy tekens te ken nie') is equally sound and consistent with CAPS's aim of recognising symbols (CAPS Life Skills, https://www.thutong.doe.gov.za/ResourceDownload.aspx?id=43252).

items.bewering: begrip aanbiddingsimbool: "'n Teken of voorwerp waaraan mense 'n geloof herken. Party word ook by aanbidding gebruik."
items.bron: Consistent with the examples in the lesson (cross, menorah, Om) and with https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Religious_symbol. Read on its own it is not too narrow and not false.

items.bewering: begrip sinagoge: "Die gebou waar Joodse mense bymekaarkom om te bid en te leer."
items.bron: https://www.britannica.com/topic/synagogue. Read on its own it identifies the synagogue uniquely.

items.bewering: begrip Torah-rol: "'n Lang boekrol waarop Joodse heilige geskrifte met die hand geskryf is."
items.bron: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Sefer-Torah. Read on its own it is true, if broad: strictly the Torah scroll carries the Five Books of Moses, and the entry would also fit, say, the Esther scroll. It is broad but not false, and does not need correcting at Grade 4.

items.bewering: begrip menora: "'n Joodse lamp met verskeie arms wat elkeen 'n lig dra."
items.bron: https://www.britannica.com/topic/menorah. Read on its own it covers both the seven-branched lamp and the nine-branched Chanukah lamp, which is also commonly called a menorah, so it is true for both.

items.bewering: begrip preekstoel: "Die verhoogde plek in 'n kerk waarvandaan iemand met die mense praat."
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pulpit ('an elevated platform ... used for preaching the sermon'); https://www.britannica.com/technology/pulpit.

items.bewering: begrip moskee: "Die gebou waar Moslems bymekaarkom om saam te bid."
items.bron: https://www.metmuseum.org/learn/educators/curriculum-resources/art-of-the-islamic-world/unit-one/the-mosque.

items.bewering: begrip minaret: "'n Hoë dun toring by 'n moskee, waarvandaan mense na die gebed geroep word."
items.bron: https://www.learnreligions.com/parts-of-a-mosque-2004464 ; Pluralism Project (https://pluralism.org/mosque-minaret-and-mihrab).

items.bewering: begrip nis: "'n Holte in 'n muur wat na binne toe insink."
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Niche_(architecture); the mihrab is such a niche (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mihrab). Read on its own it is the general word meaning, which is correct.

items.bewering: begrip Kaaba: "Die gebou in Mekka waarna Moslems draai wanneer hulle bid."
items.bron: Britannica 'Kaaba' (https://kids.britannica.com/students/article/Kaaba/44246): 'Muslims orient themselves toward this small shrine during the five daily prayers'. Read on its own it identifies the Kaaba uniquely.

items.bewering: begrip tempel: "'n Gebou waar Hindoes, Boeddhiste en mense van party ander gelowe aanbid."
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Temple; a Buddhist temple in South Africa is Nan Hua Temple, Bronkhorstspruit (https://www.nanhuatemple.org/history). 'Party ander gelowe' correctly leaves room for others (such as Jain temples, and Reform Jewish synagogues that call themselves temples) without naming them.

items.bewering: begrip Om-teken: "'n Heilige teken in Hindoeïsme wat ook 'n klank is wat mense hardop sê."
items.bron: Britannica 'Om' (https://www.britannica.com/topic/Om-Indian-religion). Om also appears in Buddhist and Jain ritual. The entry says 'in Hindoeïsme' and does not claim exclusivity, so it is not false.

items.bewering: begrip altaar: "'n Tafel of verhoogde plek waar mense bid of offers bring."
items.bron: Van Dale 'altaar' (https://www.vandale.nl/gratis-woordenboek/nederlands/betekenis/altaar) and https://www.ensie.nl/betekenis/altaar: a place of offering, and in the church the table used for prayer and communion. Read on its own it is true for both the church and the Hindu use in this lesson.

items.bewering: begrip gelowige: "Iemand wat aan 'n geloof behoort en dit uitleef."
items.bron: https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/gelowige ('believer'); Supertaal-woordeboek (https://gesellig.co.za/t/32736-gelowige/). The entry is correctly faith-neutral, as the Islam block requires.

items.bewering: begrip eerbiedig: "Om iets of iemand met sorg en met respek te behandel."
items.bron: Afrikaans Wikiwoordeboek 'eerbiedig' (https://af.wiktionary.org/wiki/eerbiedig); Supertaal-woordeboek (https://gesellig.co.za/t/35366-eerbiedig/): with respect or reverence, to honour. The entry is correct as a verb meaning.

opsomming: Alle 42 nagegaande bewerings is teen bronne bevestig — insluitend die een feitelike superlatief (Auwalmoskee as die eerste moskee in Suid-Afrika, SAHO: 'the first and oldest Mosque built in South Africa'), Moria/ZCC wat korrek tot die ZCC beperk is, en elke begrip-inskrywing wat alleen gelees steeds waar is; die les het geen eli10-blok of vergelyking om na te gaan nie, en niks hoef reggestel te word nie.
